pages.text:
Blends Heavy Oil into Lubricant, a refined turbine oil.
- 100 mB Heavy Oil makes 90 mB Lubricant in 2 seconds, using 20 FE/t.
- Heavy Oil in the top, FE into the back, Lubricant out of the left.
- Speed and Energy Upgrades work as usual.
# In the turbines
Lubricant goes in a Steam or Gas Turbine Array's lubricant tank like Heavy Oil, and adds 12% to its output instead of 8%. It spins the rotor up just as fast.
